rationale.text: A social-network link has no content and takes its name only from aria-label and title. The wording puts the name between and , and the methodology checks the content of the element, while the glossary's name computation uses aria-label before the content. The check record does not let a failure rest on the wording alone and answers cannot_tell (step 4); only the record supports this branch. axe's link-name accepts aria-label and reports no fault, so the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.
